provider_receipt.summary: Review found named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:56-89 constructs and serializes MemoryRecord values but discards them, so scan_vault provides no persistent-memory integration despite the stated interface purpose; annunimas-mnemosyne is unused. (2) src/lib.rs:13-25 is incompatible with the active ingestion contract: confidence is numeric rather than low/medium/high, and required authority, privacy, source_type, owner, review, supersession, and provenance fields are absent, preventing compliant processed notes from being parsed. (3) src/lib.rs:184-192 permits slash-containing wikilinks with parent components or absolute paths to resolve outside the vault; find_backlinks then probes and exposes existing external paths. (4) The field named backlinks at src/lib.rs:34 is populated from outgoing links in the current note, not links from other notes back to it. (5) HumanKnowledge::new checks only existence, so a regular file is accepted as a vault and scan_vault can silently return no notes. The parent receipt authenticates only a clean-tree check and contains no correctness, security, privacy, or contract-conformance evidence. No files were modified.
